html:
SMTO-CMP-0012 — The AI tried to change whether you get a final written reply

GUID: 21406939-b986-40d1-9a3c-b27f53b20e72
Slug: completion-frozen-output-contract
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • When a task starts, SMTO records whether you want a written reply at the end. The AI model tried to change that later, which only you can do. Work already done is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check the task's steps and latest reply to see what already finished; that work is saved. This error is about the final reply only, not about the work itself.
  2. To change the ending, type your wish, such as "Give me a full summary" or "No reply needed", in the message box under the task and send it. SMTO only lets a message from you change whether the task ends with a written reply.
  3. Otherwise, if the task shows Partial · resumable, select Resume on the task. The AI then finishes with the reply choice recorded at the start, without repeating finished work.

What success looks like

  • The task shows Completed, with or without a final written reply as you asked.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated. Don't restart the task just to change the reply; that would repeat its actions.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An output-contract freeze was attempted after the one-time contract slot was already set or absent, or a terminal candidate declared a __smto_terminal_output value different from the frozen contract (reason frozen_output_contract).

What this means

  • Output-contract freeze is attempted after the one-time slot is absent/already fixed, or a retained terminal candidate tries to change that accepted contract. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Output-contract freeze is attempted after the one-time slot is absent/already fixed, or a retained terminal candidate tries to change that accepted contract.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the current accepted contract with the candidate declaration and any explicit user amendment.

How to fix it

  • Compare the run's terminal_output_contract with the candidate's __smto_terminal_output (freeze in src/agent_runtime/native/output_contract.py; structure_errors and evaluate in native/final_response.py). Only a user steering amendment (output_contract.amend) may reset it; otherwise resume so the model completes under the accepted contract. The completion.output_contract Agent Check governs enforcement.
  • Use the accepted frozen output contract; do not replace it while claiming completion.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • Completion uses the accepted current contract through its supported lifecycle.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
